record.question: You cannot succeed however hard you may try.
record.explanation: Answer D: Adverbial Clause of Contrast. “However hard you may try” is concessive/contrastive; D is the closest listed category. Independent check: “However hard you may try” means despite the degree of effort; it is a concessive/contrastive adverbial clause. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
